caveats: Figures cover one provisional year and do not identify individual councils or the outcomes of spending. Provincial figures cover Pradeshiya Sabhas only. Totals and components overlap; small differences in their sums are retained. Capital expenditure includes loan repayments and therefore is broader than physical investment. In table 15.7, the final column is mislabelled as capital expenditure; its I+II formula and values identify it as total expenditure. This interpretation is recorded on every affected observation.
The source uses .. for unavailable figures and a dash for nil or negligible. Both retain their printed token and a distinct status; neither is converted to an exact zero.
grain: One 2024 provisional expenditure category and council type per reported geography; totals overlap components
notes: Provisional 2024 expenditure in thousands of Sri Lankan rupees. Municipal and urban councils are national aggregates; Pradeshiya Sabhas are shown by province and as a national total. Categories cover recurrent spending, capital spending and their components.
